feature_descriptions.profile_curv: 剖面曲率(凸=加速径流, 凹=汇水)
feature_descriptions.plan_curv: 平面曲率(凹=汇流, 凸=发散)
feature_descriptions.tang_curv: 切向曲率(垂直最大坡向)
feature_descriptions.pos_openness: 正开敞度(天空可视, 山脊高)
feature_descriptions.neg_openness: 负开敞度(地形遮挡, 谷地高)
feature_descriptions.channeling: 地形通道指数(狭管效应)
feature_descriptions.solar_pot: 太阳辐射潜力(蒸发对流)

risk_enhance_factors.debris_enhance: 泥石流增强(粗糙+凹曲+汇水)
risk_enhance_factors.lightning_enhance: 雷电增强(山脊+粗糙+海拔)
